lore.origin: Whispering Woods predators—wolves twisted by Ether saplings growing through their hides.
lore.description: Wolf silhouettes bristling with thorny branches; eyes like green lantern oil.
lore.weaknesses: Fire on brambles (disadvantage on attacks 1 round); cannot enter consecrated groves.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: Advantage on melee if ally is within 5 ft of target.

actions.name: Bramble Lash
actions.text: 10 ft; 1d6+2 and speed halved until DC 12 STR check.
